suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require hypothyroidism before incident tinnitus and separately documented tinnitus; consider hearing loss, noise exposure, vestibular disease, medication, and vascular causes. Retrospective longitudinal association only; no causal pathway metadata. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Hypothyroidism and Tinnitus
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
